_read: What the reviewer reads, in English. The fallback language: a key missing everywhere else
NOT here: logs (English, always, and not translated — a log is evidence, and evidence that
changes wording by locale cannot be grepped) and boot errors (a service that refuses to start
has no session and no chosen language yet).
`{name}` is replaced at render time. Keep the placeholder name, translate around it.
`language.name` is the one key that is NOT translated: it carries the language's own name, so
es.json says "Español" and never "Spanish". That is what the selector shows, and it is why
adding a fourth language is still one file — the selector reads the name out of the dictionary
instead of a list someone has to remember to edit.

api.users.lockHolderIsOwnerToCreate: {email}’s account is reserved: only the owner can create it here.
api.users.lockHolderIsOwnerToDisable: {email}’s account is reserved: only the owner can disable it here.
api.users.lockHolderIsOwnerToEnable: {email}’s account is reserved: only the owner can give that access back.
api.users.lockHolderPasswordIsOwnerToRes: {email}’s account is reserved: only the owner can reset that password here.
api.users.ownerCannotBeDisabled: {email} is the owner and cannot be disabled, not even by themselves: the service needs exactly one owner to start, and with none nobody would be left to approve. To hand the role over, change HOLDRIM_OWNER and restart.
api.users.ownerIsProvisionedAtBoot: {email} is the owner: that account is created by the service itself on first start, never from here. Restart with HOLDRIM_OWNER set to it.
api.users.ownerPasswordIsOwnTo: only the owner can reset the owner’s password

people.agents.confirm.revoke: Revoke the agent token of {email}? The agent stops being able to write at once.
people.agents.heading: Agents
people.agents.lede: An agent writes through its own token: it may comment, ask and move the requests it applies, and never decides, approves or locks. A token lasts until it is revoked; issuing a new one for the same address revokes the old.
people.agents.once: The agent token for {email} is shown this once. Copy it now and give it to the agent as HOLDRIM_AGENT_TOKEN; any token this address held before has stopped working.
people.confirm.disable: Take away the access of {email}? Their approvals stay, signed with their name.
people.confirm.reset: Generate a new password for {email}? The current one stops working now, and so does every open session on the account — yours too, if this is you.
people.create.heading: Give someone access
people.lede: Who can sign in. Nobody is ever deleted: an access is taken away, and every approval they gave keeps their name.
